1231 (0xFFFFU)

11087/* Field MEASEN: Enable the data acquisition. Setting this bit to zero initiates a result clear and invalidate action (this includes resetting all ready bits). The bit can only be set xxx us after it has been cleared. This bit is cleared when entering Sleep mode. Cyclic measurements are always executed, regardless of the value of this bit. Balancing is not stopped automatically (if in Active mode), as it would be permanently inhibited while measurement is active. If balancing shall be paused, please do so via the balancing control. */
11088#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_MEASEN_POS \
11089 (0U)
11090#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_MEASEN_MSK \
11091 (0x1U)
11092
11093/* Enumerated value DISABLED: Data acquisition disabled */
11094#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_MEASEN_DISABLED_ENUM_VAL \
11095 (0U)
11096
11097/* Enumerated value ENABLED: Data acquisition enabled */
11098#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_MEASEN_ENABLED_ENUM_VAL \
11099 (1U)
11100
11101/* Field BALPAUSECYCMODEN: Enable balancing autopause. This delays the start of measurements after entering Cyclic mode until the autopause counter has elapsed. This field has no effect in secondary measurement. */
11102#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSECYCMODEN_POS \
11103 (1U)
11104#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSECYCMODEN_MSK \
11105 (0x2U)
11106
11107/* Enumerated value DISABLED: Autopause for balancing is disabled. */
11108#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSECYCMODEN_DISABLED_ENUM_VAL \
11109 (0U)
11110
11111/* Enumerated value ENABLED: Autopause for balancing is enabled. Measurements are started when the autopause counter is elapsed. */
11112#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSECYCMODEN_ENABLED_ENUM_VAL \
11113 (1U)
11114
11115/* Field BALPAUSELEN: Pause of balancing before measurement cycle is executed. An on-going balancing pause operation is not influenced by a change of this value. 1 LSB = 10us. */
11116#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSELEN_POS \
11117 (2U)
11118#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSELEN_MSK \
11119 (0xFFFCU)
11120
11121/* Enumerated value NO_PAUSE: No Pause. */

11123 (0U)
11124
11125/* Enumerated value PAUSE_10u: Pause = 10 us */
11126#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSELEN_PAUSE_10U_ENUM_VAL \
11127 (1U)
11128
11129/* Enumerated value MAX: Maximum pause = 163830 us = 163 ms */
11130#define MC33775_SECM_CFG_BALPAUSELEN_MAX_ENUM_VAL \
11131 (16383U)

13435/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
13436 * BAL_GLOB_CFG (read-write):The global balancing configuration register is used to configure the balancing modes.
13437 * -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
13438#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_OFFSET \
13439 (0x1000U)
13440#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_RW_MSK \
13441 (0x31FU)
13442#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_RD_MSK \
13443 (0x31FU)
13444#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_WR_MSK \
13445 (0x31FU)
13446#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_MW_MSK \
13447 (0x0U)
13448#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_RA_MSK \
13449 (0x0U)
13450#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_POR_MSK \
13451 (0xffffU)
13452#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_POR_VAL \
13453 (0x0U)
13454
13455/* Field BALEN: Enables the balancing activity. This bit is cleared in case of a balancing timeout or if an enabled global under-voltage condition is reached. All channel individual counters are stopped if zero. The emergency discharge works without setting this bit. */
13456#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_BALEN_POS \
13457 (0U)
13458#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_BALEN_MSK \
13459 (0x1U)
13460
13461/* Enumerated value DISABLED: Balancing is disabled. */
13462#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_BALEN_DISABLED_ENUM_VAL \
13463 (0U)
13464
13465/* Enumerated value ENABLED: Balancing is enabled. */
13466#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_BALEN_ENABLED_ENUM_VAL \
13467 (1U)
13468
13469/* Field TMRBALEN: Enables the timer based balancing feature. All channel individual counters are stopped if zero. */
13470#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_TMRBALEN_POS \
13471 (1U)
13472#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_TMRBALEN_MSK \
13473 (0x2U)
13474
13475/* Enumerated value INDEPENDENT: Balancing is independent of the cell balancing timer. */
13476#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_TMRBALEN_INDEPENDENT_ENUM_VAL \
13477 (0U)
13478
13479/* Enumerated value STOP: Balancing for all cells will be stopped when cell balancing timer expires. */
13480#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_TMRBALEN_STOP_ENUM_VAL \
13481 (1U)
13482
13483/* Field CHUV0BALEN: Enables the voltage based balancing for the individual channel. Balancing stops once each individual channel reaches the under-voltage threshold. */
13484#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_CHUV0BALEN_POS \
13485 (2U)
13486#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_CHUV0BALEN_MSK \
13487 (0x4U)
13488
13489/* Enumerated value INDEPENDENT: Balancing is independent of the cell undervoltage threshold. */
13490#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_CHUV0BALEN_INDEPENDENT_ENUM_VAL \
13491 (0U)
13492
13493/* Enumerated value STOP: Balancing for the individual cells stops once the cell undervoltage threshold is reached. */
13494#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_CHUV0BALEN_STOP_ENUM_VAL \
13495 (1U)
13496
13497/* Field GLOBUV1BALEN: Enables the Global undervoltage based balancing feature. */
13498#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_GLOBUV1BALEN_POS \
13499 (3U)
13500#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_GLOBUV1BALEN_MSK \
13501 (0x8U)
13502
13503/* Enumerated value INDEPENDENT: Balancing is independent of the global undervoltage threshold. */
13504#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_GLOBUV1BALEN_INDEPENDENT_ENUM_VAL \
13505 (0U)
13506
13507/* Enumerated value STOP: Balancing for all cells stops once the global undervoltage threshold is reached by any cell. */
13508#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_GLOBUV1BALEN_STOP_ENUM_VAL \
13509 (1U)
13510
13511/* Field TEMPMODBALEN: Enables the temperature modulated balancing. After an over-temperature condition the balancing is halted until an under-temperature condition is detected. */
13512#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_TEMPMODBALEN_POS \
13513 (4U)
13514#define MC33775_BAL_GLOB_CFG_TEMPMODBALEN_MSK \
13515 (0x10U)
